record.title: Cybersecurity Standard Practice Guide — Artificial Intelligence Application Security Guidelines: Radio, TV and Network Audiovisual
record.original_title: 网络安全标准实践指南——人工智能应用安全指引 广播电视和网络视听
record.short_title: TC260-PG-202611A (AI application security, radio, TV and network audiovisual)
record.issuing_body: National Cybersecurity Standardization Technical Committee (TC260) Secretariat; Department of Science and Technology, National Radio and Television Administration
record.summary: Guide for radio, TV and network audiovisual services in TC260's AI application security guidelines, issued with the NRTA Department of Science and Technology and used with the general part (TC260-PG-20268A). It bars AI-generated current-affairs news and digital humans as current-affairs news presenters, requires prominent notice of AI-generated programmes and keeping explicit and metadata labels through production and broadcast, and calls for multi-level human review, manual override and rollback, no impersonation of others' likeness or voice, fact-checking, and measures against information cocoons.
record.notes: Version v1.0-202609, released on 15 Sept 2026 with notice 网安秘字〔2026〕118号 together with the general provisions and the education and health guides. Programmes made with AI must not contain the listed prohibited content, and AI-generated micro-short dramas must carry a notice in each episode under the Micro-short Drama Development Management Measures. Generative AI services offered to the public must meet GB/T 45654 (CN-10) and GB 45438 (CN-08), and training data work must meet GB/T 45652 and GB/T 45674. For distribution it asks for explanation of recommendation algorithms, a one-click switch to non-preferred content and a minors' mode. Annex A lists 31 AI application scenarios in the sector and their main risks.

verification.note: Stored from tc260.org.cn: the guide's PDF (version v1.0-202609) and the release notice 网安秘字〔2026〕118号 of 15 Sept 2026 with the four guides attached to it. Title, number, issuer, date and contents are confirmed from these; the summary follows the Chinese text. No English version was found. The notice copy is flagged for review because the page names this guide only in its attachment list; its text is complete.

judgment.status_reasoning: The TC260 Secretariat released the guide with notice 网安秘字〔2026〕118号 of 15 Sept 2026 (关于发布 ... 的通知, a release notice, not a call for comments); the cover carries a released version number (v1.0-202609) and no draft marking (征求意见稿). The preface describes practice guides as technical documents the TC260 Secretariat drafts and publishes to give practical guidance, so it is not binding; no later version is stored.
